title: CUPE airport demonstrations opposing the federal back-to-work order in Air Canada dispute
location: Outside Pearson (Toronto), Montréal–Trudeau, Vancouver and Calgary airports
scope: Coordinated union demonstrations at four airports opposing federal intervention in the ongoing Air Canada flight-attendant labour dispute.
organizer: Canadian Union of Public Employees (CUPE); Canadian Labour Congress expressed a broader union position
participants_original: Unknown. The 10,000 workers represented by CUPE is not a turnout figure.
threshold_50_evidence: Canadian Press reports demonstrations at four airports, but gives no crowd estimate at any site. No evidence establishes >=50 simultaneous attendees.

start_date.summary: Canadian Press reports CUPE held demonstrations Sunday, Aug. 17.

location.summary: Outside airports in Toronto, Montreal, Vancouver and Calgary.

scope.summary: Four-site coordinated union action; distinct from the broader Air Canada strike and from the prior Aug. 11 planned action.

organizer.summary: CUPE held demonstrations; Canadian Labour Congress publicly supported the members.

participants.summary: No demonstration attendance provided; workforce size of 10,000 is not substituted for attendance.

state_target.summary: Unions asked the federal government to withdraw its intervention and remove Labour Code s.107; order arose from Canada Industrial Relations Board action.

demand.summary: Withdraw federal back-to-work/arbitration intervention and repeal Labour Code s.107; underlying wage demands remained part of the Air Canada bargaining dispute.

state_target: Federal Government of Canada / Canada Industrial Relations Board; the reported demonstrations included an explicit demand for federal withdrawal of intervention and repeal of s.107.
notes: Private-employer pay demands are kept analytically separate; only the public airport demonstrations and explicit federal-policy demand support this candidate.
open_questions: How many demonstrators were simultaneously at each airport?
Were the demonstrations distinct from picket lines and the strike activity?

title: Líl̓wat Nation rally and highway demonstration over Joffre Lakes closure
location: Highway 99 near Joffre Lakes Provincial Park, British Columbia
scope: Líl̓wat Nation members publicly opposed the park’s closure schedule and sought a longer period for Indigenous cultural practice.
threshold_50_evidence: Opened article verifies a rally and temporary highway blockage but provides no count. >=50 simultaneous participants is not established.

start_date.summary: CityNews dates the rally to August 22, 2025.

location.summary: Highway 99 by Joffre Lakes Provincial Park.

scope.summary: Local Indigenous action over park closure timing.

organizer.summary: Líl̓wat Nation members; individual organizers unknown.

state_target.summary: Demand addressed to British Columbia over park closure schedule.

demand.summary: Extend the closure to enable Indigenous cultural practice.

state_response.summary: Specific state response/negotiation outcome not established.

state_target: British Columbia provincial government / park authority.
notes: Do not use traffic or vehicle totals as protest attendance.
open_questions: What exact closure dates were requested and what did BC decide?

title: Youth rally at Queen’s Park concludes Timmins walk against Bills 5 and C-5
scope: Search results describe a youth rally celebrating walkers who challenged Ontario Bill 5 and federal Bill C-5.
participants_original: A search result says more than 80 supporters attended; unverified in an opened body.
threshold_50_evidence: Search-only result reports >80 supporters, but actual occurrence/date and simultaneous turnout have not been verified from an opened body.

location.summary: Search result names Queen’s Park, Toronto.

participants.summary: Search-result snippet reports over 80 supporters; not verified from body.

state_target.summary: Search-result headline describes opposition to provincial Bill 5 and federal Bill C-5.

demand.summary: Search-only; challenges Bills 5/C-5 are the described issue, exact policy demands unknown.

state_target: Ontario and federal governments, as described in search result; exact demands unverified.
notes: Potential culmination of July walk; kept separate by month occurrence. Search-only attendance claim is not treated as verified.
open_questions: What date did the rally occur?
Can an opened report verify the >80 simultaneous count and explicit demands?
